entities.name: Michael the Brave & First Romanian Union
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Michael the Brave (Mihai Viteazul) briefly united Wallachia, Moldavia, and Transylvania (1600) — a foundational moment in Romanian national mythology. His assassination (1601) ended the union, but it inspired later unification movements.
